snapshotIssueConditions.retirement: Retire duplicate copy/currentness owners only after all admitted paths route through this issuer

snapshotIssueConditions.issueGuard: Exact boot stage/tool closure, target/options/prelude/env/cwd; controlled initial evaluator/reader/hook state; successful or explicitly failed lifecycle

snapshotIssueConditions.proofTarget: Prove initialization and exceptional cleanup restore/terminate the admitted context; env.begin/end alone is insufficient

snapshotIssueConditions.retirement: Replace repeated ad hoc effective-config interpretation only after parity
snapshotIssueConditions.benefitBoundary: Fresh producer isolates previous mutable state but neither proves deterministic macros nor blocks host effects

snapshotIssueConditions.issueGuard: Every effect influencing requests/output is mediated or explicitly fixed; untracked macro/readtable/native capabilities denied for reusable profile

snapshotIssueConditions.proofTarget: Translate admitted Scheme evaluator path to closed ReadProgram; prove all macro and reader callbacks obey capability policy
snapshotIssueConditions.addedSupport: Evaluator/readtable/native capability boundary plus audit trail
snapshotIssueConditions.retirement: An include-only recorder cannot retire conservative host-effect handling
snapshotIssueConditions.benefitBoundary: Can reduce false dependencies only when mediation is complete; tracing overhead remains

snapshotIssueConditions.issueGuard: Required producer validated under same image and stage; complete immutable group; unique committed identity and leased lifetime before dependent read
snapshotIssueConditions.failureCustody: Uncommitted or unknown group remains producer-owned; consumer waits/restarts without consuming stale output
snapshotIssueConditions.proofTarget: Prove producer-before-file-read and append-only group catalogue with conflicting-commit invalidation
snapshotIssueConditions.addedSupport: Group manifests, pending dependency ownership, reader leases
snapshotIssueConditions.retirement: Replace scattered product-existence acceptance only when all concrete consumers migrate
snapshotIssueConditions.benefitBoundary: Metadata cutoff can reuse observations after revalidation; changed bytes still require native object work

snapshotIssueConditions.issueGuard: Successful finite mediated run; ordered answer trace; no unresolved dependency reads/effects; same initial producer context; every consumed answer tied to image/group receipts
snapshotIssueConditions.failureCustody: Failed/unfinished trace is historical diagnostic evidence, not reusable success; leases stay with attempt until drain
snapshotIssueConditions.proofTarget: adaptiveTraceReplay and adaptiveOutputUnique are checked only for the abstract reader; actual translation is open
snapshotIssueConditions.addedSupport: Ordered trace plus dependency/effect completion and failure records
snapshotIssueConditions.retirement: Retire duplicate dynamic dependency recording only after one trace owner covers every path
snapshotIssueConditions.benefitBoundary: Old trace can validate an adaptive branch without rerunning a closed producer; cannot infer closure from no new edges

snapshotIssueConditions.issueGuard: Successful producer exit, complete output group/schema and settled I/O; receipts bind all source and catalogue observations; no outstanding authority borrowers
snapshotIssueConditions.failureCustody: Attempt owner retains staging and borrowed resources on partial failure; no synthetic success
snapshotIssueConditions.proofTarget: Prove source result lifecycle and complete-group custody; current frontend return is not a publication receipt
snapshotIssueConditions.addedSupport: Staging owner, output/schema inventory, process/IO drain
snapshotIssueConditions.retirement: Retire scattered success/exit translation only after complete caller replacement
snapshotIssueConditions.benefitBoundary: Avoid repeated wrapper decisions; no promise of zero validation work

snapshotIssueConditions.issueGuard: Under same issuer linearization authority: source cohort not revoked, dependency receipts current, group complete; publish one manifest pointer
snapshotIssueConditions.failureCustody: Writer first rejects admission; publisher first creates valid historical group later revocable; unknown commit retains single custody
